title: Seven Lines in the Book
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：achievement　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 achievement 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the paper came out without her name on it, and my aunt said nothing, and the ① achievement, meaning the discovery everybody called a breakthrough, went into the book under two other names and stayed there for thirty-one years. She had called it an achievement once, in a letter to me, and had crossed the word out and written the ② achievement of one question instead, which I understood only much later.

The ③ achievement in optics was seven lines long in the book, and the wrong seven lines, and she said the word achievement is what people use when they have stopped asking how something was done. There was ④ no great achievement in the work itself, she said — it was eleven years of one measurement repeated — and she said the ⑤ achievement, if there was one, was that she had not stopped.

Her school report in 1946 said her ⑥ academic achievement was poor and that she asked too many questions, and she kept the report for fifty-two years and showed it to me on the day I failed my own. She said a sense of ⑦ achievement is the thing that keeps people from finishing anything, and I have never decided whether she meant it.

In 1999 the university gave her a medal and called the ⑧ achievement hers, and she was eighty-one and said the ⑨ achievement of a name on a paper is not the same as the achievement of the thing itself, and that she had never wanted the medal, only the measurement to be right. They put the medal in a drawer with the 1946 report, and she never took either out again.

The ⑩ achievement I would put in the book is not the discovery but the eleven years, seven of them with nobody watching, and the fact that she wrote the number down the same way every single time. An achievement, she said on the last day I saw her, is only ever the part of the work that somebody else can see, and if this is an achievement at all it is an achievement of patience.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 成就；成绩（泛指）
B. n. 了不起的事；难能之举（an achievement of patience / courage）
C. n. （学业）成绩；学业成就（academic achievement）
D. n. 功绩；伟绩（a scientific achievement）
E. 固定搭配：a great / remarkable achievement 一项了不起的成就
F. 固定搭配：achievement in ... 在……方面的成就
G. 固定搭配：the achievement of ... ……的实现／达成
H. 固定搭配：a sense of achievement 成就感

items.q: written the achievement of one question
The achievement in optics was seven lines
There was no great achievement in the work
she said the achievement, if there was one
a sense of achievement is the thing
the achievement of a name on a paper
The achievement I would put in the book

answers.why: achievement 意为“成就、成绩”，指 1968 年那篇论文里的发现，被记在了另外两个人名下。
the achievement of ... 意为“……的实现／达成”，她划掉“成就”，改写为“一个问题的解答”。
achievement in ... 意为“在……方面的成就”，书中关于光学方面的成就只有七行，而且是错的七行。
a great achievement 意为“一项了不起的成就”，她说工作本身谈不上什么了不起的成就。
achievement 意为“成就”，她说如果真有什么成就，那就是她没有停下来。
academic achievement 意为“学业成绩”，1946 年的成绩单说她的学业成绩很差。
a sense of achievement 意为“成就感”，她说成就感恰恰让人做不成事。
achievement 意为“功绩、伟绩”，1999 年大学把这项科学功绩归到了她名下。
the achievement of ... 意为“……的实现”，她说名字印在论文上不等于事情本身的实现。
an achievement of patience 意为“一项靠耐心才做到的事”，难能之举，而不是通常说的成就。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年那篇论文发表时没有她的名字，这项成就被记在了另外两个人名下。（achievement）
她在给我的信里把“成就”划掉，改写成“一个问题的解答”。（the achievement of）
书中记载的光学成就只有七行，而且是错的七行。（achievement in）
她 1946 年的成绩单说她学业成绩很差，理由是她提问太多。（academic achievement）
她说成就感会让人做不成事，我至今不知道她是不是认真的。（a sense of achievement）
如果说这也算一项成就，那它是一项靠耐心才做到的成就。（an achievement of）
answers: The achievement went into the book under two other names in 1968, and her name was not on the paper.
In a letter to me she crossed the word out and wrote the achievement of one question instead.
The achievement in optics was seven lines long in the book, and the wrong seven lines.
Her school report of 1946 said her academic achievement was poor and that she asked too many questions.
She said a sense of achievement is the thing that keeps people from finishing anything.
If this is an achievement at all, it is an achievement of patience.
